Method of Attack: Checks for unprotected MongoDB instances vulnerable to remote access
Detects security misconfigurations and known CVE vulnerabilities in MongoDB servers
Requires credentials for advanced scans to verify user permissions and roles
Attack Vector: Remote scanning of MongoDB server URLs and ports
Credential-based access for advanced permission checks
Indicators of Compromise: URLs and ports of MongoDB servers
MongoDB HTTP status interface accessibility on port 28017
Authentication and SCRAM-SHA-1 method enabled status
User roles and CRUD operation permissions
